name: EventEmitter
abi_source: Curated minimal subset of indexed event signatures (EventLog/EventLog1/EventLog2). Wave does NOT bind EventEmitter directly — only Reader is read in this PR. Pinned here for completeness so a future Wave (e.g. WebSocket subscription to position events for live PnL streaming) has the binding point.
notes: GMX V2's diamond-style event hub. Indexed by eventNameHash for filtering.
